Marksmanship Hunter

WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

Levelling and level 60 guide for the live game. The builds are Icy Veins' and Wowhead's, named and dated; both were written at or just after launch, before the November 10 tuning. Numbers are the client's with hotfixes through November 12. Claims about Lone WolfLone WolfTalentCastInstantYou deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet. and Sniper ShotSniper ShotLevel 40 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 3Cast4 sec castCost365 ManaRange45 yd rangeCooldown15 sec cooldownDuration10 secA long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 320 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec. at 60 cite WoWSims, a model. No raid is open until December 9. Where a hover tooltip and the text disagree, believe the text: tooltips can lag a hotfix.

What Marksmanship is for

The tree raises what your own shots do. Lethal AttacksLethal AttacksTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 5%. is +5% crit with all attacks at 5/5. Careful AimCareful AimTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases your Attack Power by 100% of your Intellect. adds up to 100% of your Intellect to both melee and ranged Attack Power. Mortal ShotsMortal ShotsTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by 30%. raises ranged crit damage, BarrageBarrageTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantIncreases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 15%. raises Aimed ShotAimed ShotLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6Cast2 sec castCost75 ManaRange35 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownAn aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 40. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot., Multi-ShotMulti-ShotLevel 18 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost13.9% of base ManaRange35 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownFires several missiles, hitting 3 targets. Multi-Shot shares its cooldown with Aimed Shot. and VolleyVolleyLevel 40 · Spell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost350 ManaRange35 yd rangeDuration6 secContinuously fires a volley of ammo at the target area, causing 70 Arcane damage to enemy targets within 8 yards every 1 sec for 6 sec. by up to 15%, and Ranged Weapon SpecializationRanged Weapon SpecializationTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by 5%. adds 5% ranged damage.

It also pays its own Mana. Rapid KillingRapid KillingTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantReduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by 2 min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot ability within 20 sec by 20%. cuts Rapid FireRapid FireLevel 26 · Spell · ArcaneCastInstantCost100 ManaCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases ranged and melee attack speed by 40% for 15 sec.'s cooldown by 2 minutes at 2/2 and gives your next Shot +20% damage after a kill. Rapid RecuperationRapid RecuperationTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantAfflicting a target with Serpent Sting allows 50% of your Mana Regeneration to continue while casting for 15 sec, increased to 100% when Rapid Killing is consumed. lets Mana regeneration continue while casting after a Serpent StingSerpent StingLevel 4 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 9CastInstantCost15 ManaRange35 yd rangeDuration15 secStings the target, causing 15 Nature damage over 15 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.. Icy Veins calls the pair "incredibly important" and says it "will solve almost all of your mana issues while leveling."

Lone WolfLone WolfTalentCastInstantYou deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet. gives +20% damage with all attacks, and only with no pet out. It is the one talent in the Hunter trees that pays you for fighting without a pet. Both sites leave it out of their levelling builds. Wowhead: it "isn't really an option while leveling since you need a pet to tank for you." At 60, both sites and WoWSims print a Lone WolfLone WolfTalentCastInstantYou deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet. build (see below).

Icy Veins' levelling page describes the cost of the spec plainly: it buffs the player instead of the pet, so the pet holds threat less well and you lean more on Mana. That is a statement about solo levelling with a pet tank.

What decides each press:

  • Stand still for Auto Shot. Blizzard's notes say Auto Shot needs 0.5 seconds standing still before it fires, and that it keeps firing while you cast Aimed ShotAimed ShotLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6Cast2 sec castCost75 ManaRange35 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownAn aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 40. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot. or Sniper ShotSniper ShotLevel 40 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 3Cast4 sec castCost365 ManaRange45 yd rangeCooldown15 sec cooldownDuration10 secA long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 320 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.. So a cast costs you no Auto Shots and walking does.
  • Serpent StingSerpent StingLevel 4 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 9CastInstantCost15 ManaRange35 yd rangeDuration15 secStings the target, causing 15 Nature damage over 15 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target. or Arcane ShotArcane ShotLevel 6 · Spell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost11% of base ManaRange35 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownAn instant shot that causes 25 Arcane damage.. The sting is the better use of Mana if the target lives. Rank 3 costs 50 Mana and deals 70 over 15 seconds, against 50 for Arcane Shot at level 20. Rank 4 costs 80 and deals 130, against 85 at level 28. All before attack power, which widens the gap: each tick of the sting adds 5% of it, 25% over the full sting, against 15% for Arcane Shot. Those shares are Blizzard's November 2 figures, and WoWSims reports level 34 and 36 combat logs fit both. The sting passes Arcane Shot on its fourth tick, at 12 seconds. In a group, Rapid KillingRapid KillingTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantReduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by 2 min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot ability within 20 sec by 20%. also triggers when a target dies with your sting on it, so a kill you did not land still pays.

Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot.. They share a 6-second cooldown, so you get one or the other. Aimed Shot is your weapon hit plus a flat bonus: 40 at rank 1, 70 at rank 2, up to 350 at rank 6. Multi-Shot is the weapon hit with no bonus, on up to three targets. Each extra target adds a whole weapon hit, so two targets beat Aimed Shot once your weapon hit is larger than that bonus. Lone WolfLone WolfTalentCastInstantYou deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet. and BarrageBarrageTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantIncreases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 15%. raise both alike, so neither changes that answer.

It is a 4-second cast on a 15-second cooldown for weapon damage plus 320 at rank 1, 450 at 48 and 590 at 58, and it costs 365 Mana. WoWSims casts it only when nothing else is ready, because it deals the least damage per second of casting, and still gains about 43 DPS on its preset by taking it. It also opens the fight with one, started before the pull (WoWSims' model). Stat priority

While levelling: weapon damage, then Agility, then the highest item level you can wear. The slower weapon is better: Aimed ShotAimed ShotLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6Cast2 sec castCost75 ManaRange35 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownAn aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 40. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot. scales off damage per hit, not DPS. Intellect is worth more here than on any other physical spec once Careful AimCareful AimTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases your Attack Power by 100% of your Intellect. is in, at level 19 on Icy Veins' order.

At 60 the two sites agree on the order and disagree on the hit cap. Both list hit, then crit, then Agility, then Intellect, then Attack Power. Wowhead says 9% hit and labels its list speculative. Icy Veins says 8%.

What Forever changed for Hunters

  • Pets scale their stats off your gear, and can no longer receive player buffs that increase their stats. On November 10 Blizzard set pet Health to 115% of normal, down from a bugged 150%. Whether a pet's family changes its damage is disputed between the sites; the client's table is on the Hunter overview.
  • Improved Serpent StingImproved Serpent StingTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases the damage done by your Serpent Sting by 10%. became Improved StingsImproved StingsTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantIncreases the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by 20%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by 6 sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by 45 sec. At level 60

The builds and the rotation above are published. What is not yet known is how they hold in a raid: none opens until December 9. The open question is Lone WolfLone WolfTalentCastInstantYou deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet. against a pet after the November 10 tuning. The sites' builds predate it and no source has re-measured. In a dungeon either works: with a pet, keep it on the tank's target; without one, you bring Trueshot AuraTrueshot AuraTalent · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost180 ManaDuration1800 secIncreases the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within 45 yds by 20. and the area tools above.
